name: CrowdRingCircle pair-reserve burn
summary: CRC's sell hook burned the sold amount from the receiving DEX pair's own balance and called sync() before crediting the seller. With flash-loaned USDT the attacker bought almost all CRC out of the pair (routed to the restriction-exempt owner), then sold CRC equal to the pair's remainder, burning its reserve to dust, and swapped it for the pair's USDT.
notes: The reset is setDexPair(pair, true), which registered the CRC/USDT pair and so enabled the burn-and-sync sell path the exploit needed; sellDestroyEnabled is a feature gate set at deployment, and the later feeReceiver and exemption changes were not needed.

Loss is the pair's net USDT outflow; the CRC that left the pair went to the owner or was burned and is not valued separately (unpriced, realised only through the drained USDT). BurnFromPair logs show no other tx collapsing the pair balance, so there is no campaign.
